row: Animaux Clinique, located in Thane and led by Dr. Sachi Shanbhag . She has been a trusted small animal practice for over eight years. Dr. Shanbhag is a dedicated advocate of fear-free handling and fostering a fear-free environment. The clinic is designed to prioritize the emotional well-being of pets alongside their physical health. Additionally, Animaux Clinique is committed to advancing the veterinary profession by mentoring students and supporting aspiring professionals through educational initiatives. This holistic approach reflects the clinic’s mission to elevate both animal welfare and veterinary standards. This channel will be used solely to learn from Experts of various fields of Veterinary. There will be easy to learn and remember topics  that will be covered. Mentorship is important for growth and learning. Hope the visiting Mentors are helpful to all Vet Students.
